capabilities.reason: Nexus is an intelligence dashboard, not an ERP. ERPNext's core product is entirely outside scope.

capabilities.reason: ERPNext's DocType pattern (schema → auto-generated UI) is a useful reference for Nexus settings/configuration form generation.

capabilities.title: Double-entry accounting engine with chart of accounts and reporting
capabilities.reason: Accounting engine is outside Nexus scope.

capabilities.title: Dynamic report builder: define report columns, filters, and charts without code
capabilities.sourceEvidence: ERPNext report builder: query reports and script reports
capabilities.reason: Nexus INTEL dashboard building could reference ERPNext's dynamic report builder UX for configurable metric views.
